text: As a child, Theo was fascinated by the stars and spent countless nights stargazing from the rooftop of his rural home. This love for astronomy was more than just a hobby; it was a bond with his late mother, an astrophysicist who nurtured his curiosity about the universe. She would often point out the constellations, but she also taught him that the fluffy things in the sky, the soft white clouds, were the very source from which rain comes, connecting the celestial above with the life-giving water below.
